situations.title: 경련 목격 문진
situations.tagline: He just dropped and started shaking—it lasted maybe a minute.
situations.brief: 경련의 지속시간·양상·발작 후 상태를 목격자에게 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: How long did the shaking last?
Was his whole body shaking or just one side?
How was he right after it stopped?

situations.title: 의식수준 GCS 사정
situations.tagline: Where... where am I? What happened to me?
situations.brief: 눈·언어·운동 반응으로 GCS를 사정해 의식수준을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you open your eyes for me?
Do you know where you are right now?
Squeeze my fingers as hard as you can.

situations.title: 즉시 혈당 확인
situations.tagline: I feel so weak and sweaty—I skipped my meals today.
situations.brief: 즉시 혈당을 확인해 저혈당성 원인을 배제하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking your blood sugar right now.
When did you last eat something?
Do you take insulin or any diabetes pills?

situations.title: 낙상·손상 방지 설명
situations.tagline: Should I hold him down? I don't know what to do!
situations.brief: 측위·기도 보호·억제 금지 원칙을 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Never hold him down or put anything in his mouth.
We turn him on his side to protect his airway.
Just clear the area so he doesn't get hurt.

situations.title: 발작력·복약 청취
situations.tagline: I have epilepsy, but I ran out of my pills last week.
situations.brief: 항경련제 복용·중단 여부 등 발작력과 복약력을 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: How long have you had seizures?
What medications do you take for them?
When did you last take your medication?

situations.title: 첫 발작 성인
situations.tagline: I've never had anything like this before—what caused it?
situations.brief: 성인 첫 발작의 유발요인을 문진하고 정밀검사의 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you been sleeping and eating normally?
Any recent illness, alcohol, or new medications?
We'll do tests to find out why this happened.

situations.title: 발작 후 혼돈(postictal)
situations.tagline: Who are you? Why am I here... wait, who are you again?
situations.brief: 발작 후 혼돈 상태에서 지남력을 반복 재사정하세요.
keyPhrases: You're in the emergency room; you had a seizure.
Can you tell me your name and today's date?
It's okay, this confusion will clear up soon.

situations.title: 항경련제 누락 재발
situations.tagline: I stopped my meds because I felt fine—now this happened again.
situations.brief: 순응도와 혈중농도를 사정하고 항경련제 누락에 따른 재발을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: How long have you been off your medication?
We'll check your medication level in your blood.
Stopping suddenly can trigger seizures like this.

situations.title: 알코올 금단 발작
situations.tagline: I quit drinking three days ago and I've been shaking all over.
situations.brief: 마지막 음주 시각과 자율신경 증상을 사정해 알코올 금단 발작을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: When was your very last drink?
How much do you usually drink in a day?
Are you having sweats, tremors, or seeing things?

situations.title: 열성 경련 소아 부모 안심
situations.tagline: She turned blue and stiff—I thought she was dying!
situations.brief: 공포에 빠진 부모를 안심시키고 열성 경련의 경과를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Febrile seizures are frightening but usually harmless.
She's breathing well now and starting to recover.
Let's focus on bringing her fever down.

situations.title: 임신부 자간증 발작
situations.tagline: I'm 34 weeks pregnant and my head has been killing me all day.
situations.brief: 혈압·부종을 사정하고 산과 협진을 조율하며 자간증 발작을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: How many weeks pregnant are you?
Have you had swelling in your face or hands?
We're checking your blood pressure and calling OB.

situations.title: 실신 vs 발작 감별
situations.tagline: I just passed out at work—people said I twitched a little.
situations.brief: 목격 정보를 활용해 실신과 발작을 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Did you feel lightheaded before you passed out?
How quickly did you recover afterward?
Did anyone see stiffening or shaking?

situations.title: 저나트륨성 의식저하
situations.tagline: I've been so confused and nauseous—I drink tons of water daily.
situations.brief: 전해질 이상을 의심하고 저나트륨성 의식저하를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: How much water do you drink each day?
Any recent vomiting or diarrhea?
We're checking your electrolytes right now.

situations.title: 약물 과량 의식저하
situations.tagline: Please... take these... he isn't waking up... pinpoint eyes.
situations.brief: 동공·호흡을 사정하고 날록손 적응을 판단하며 약물 과량 의식저하에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: What did he take, and how much?
His pupils are pinpoint and breathing is slow.
We're giving naloxone right now.

situations.title: 언어장벽 발작 병력
situations.tagline: Seizure... before... yes. Medicine... no take.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자에서 최근 발작·복약 정보를 몸짓과 통역으로 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Seizure before—point to how many times.
Medicine—do you take it? Yes or no?
I'm getting an interpreter for you.

situations.title: 지속상태(status epilepticus)
situations.tagline: He's been seizing for over five minutes—it won't stop!
situations.brief: 5분 이상 지속되는 경련에 벤조디아제핀 투여를 준비하며 지속상태에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a prolonged seizure and it's an emergency.
We're giving medication to stop it now.
We're protecting his airway and giving oxygen.

situations.title: 의식저하 기도 위기
situations.tagline: *gurgling breaths, unresponsive*
situations.brief: 흡인·저환기가 동반된 의식저하 환자의 기도를 확보하고 삽관을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: We're suctioning and repositioning your airway.
Oxygen saturation is dropping—bag-mask now.
Preparing for intubation to protect the airway.

situations.title: 저혈당 혼수 급속교정
situations.tagline: *unresponsive, cold sweat, blood sugar 28*
situations.brief: 포도당 투여로 저혈당 혼수를 교정하고 재저하 여부를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving IV dextrose to raise your sugar.
Tell me your name once you can hear me.
We'll recheck your sugar to make sure it stays up.

situations.title: 발작 후 급성 결손
situations.tagline: After the seizure my left arm just won't move at all.
situations.brief: 발작 후 지속되는 국소 결손에서 Todd 마비와 뇌졸중을 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you lift your left arm at all?
Is the weakness getting better or staying the same?
We need a scan to rule out a stroke.

situations.title: 의식저하 SBAR 인계
situations.tagline: Handing off the altered-mental-status patient—GCS, meds, glucose.
situations.brief: GCS·투약·혈당 중심으로 의식저하 환자를 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: GCS was 8 on arrival, now improved to 12.
He received 4mg lorazepam and IV dextrose.
Last glucose was 90; airway is currently stable.

situations.title: 다약물 중독 혼수
situations.tagline: *unresponsive, multiple empty pill bottles found nearby*
situations.brief: 원인 불명 혼수에서 다약물 중독을 의심하고 광범위 감별을 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: We found several empty bottles—checking what they were.
Monitoring your breathing and heart rhythm closely.
We're screening for toxins and supporting you.
